name: Jayabharat Credit Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1943,  Jayabharat Credit 
Ltd was in the business of Hire Purchase 
and leasing[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
JCL initially operated in General Insurance as a subsidiary of The New India Assurance Company. It later transitioned into Hire Purchase and Leasing, becoming a Deposit-taking NBFC registered with RBI and a Category I Merchant Banker under SEBI. However, in FY20, the company ceased its NBFC operations and is currently non-operational, with no active business activities.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
